<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def srows(fr): 
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); return [r for r,l in enumerate(a) if 'S' in l]
print('wall now:', srows(current_frame))
r1=action(['UP'])
print('after UP wall:', srows(current_frame), 'changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
r2=action(['LEFT'])
print('after LEFT wall:', srows(current_frame), 'changed:', last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
# check if anything else changed: B/Y bboxes
from collections import deque
def comps(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); seen=[[False]*len(a[0]) for _ in a]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c0 in range(len(a[0])):
            if a[r][c0]==ch and not seen[r][c0]:
                q=deque([(r,c0)]); seen[r][c0]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    r0,c1=q.popleft(); comp.append((r0,c1))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        r2,c2=r0+dr,c1+dc
                        if 0<=r2<len(a) and 0<=c2<len(a[0]) and a[r2][c2]==ch and not seen[r2][c2]:
                            seen[r2][c2]=True; q.append((r2,c2))
                out.append((min(p[0] for p in comp),max(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp),max(p[1] for p in comp),len(comp)))
    return out
print('B:', [c for c in comps(current_frame,'B') if c[3]<63])
print('Y:', [c for c in comps(current_frame,'Y') if c[3]<63])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

from collections import deque
def comps(fr,ch):
    a=fr.ascii.splitlines(); seen=[[False]*len(a[0]) for _ in a]; out=[]
    for r in range(len(a)):
        for c0 in range(len(a[0])):
            if a[r][c0]==ch and not seen[r][c0]:
                q=deque([(r,c0)]); seen[r][c0]=True; comp=[]
                while q:
                    r0,c1=q.popleft(); comp.append((r0,c1))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        r2,c2=r0+dr,c1+dc
                        if 0<=r2<len(a) and 0<=c2<len(a[0]) and a[r2][c2]==ch and not seen[r2][c2]:
                            seen[r2][c2]=True; q.append((r2,c2))
                out.append((min(p[0] for p in comp),max(p[0] for p in comp),min(p[1] for p in comp),max(p[1] for p in comp),len(comp)))
    return out
